### 1. Individual Income Tax Due Dates & Extensions (Tax Years 2025 & 2026)

* **Return Due Date:** Calendar-year individual returns (Form IN-111) are due on **April 15** following the close of the tax year (e.g., April 15, 2026, for TY 2025; April 15, 2027, for TY 2026; if the 15th falls on a weekend or holiday, the deadline moves to the next business day).
* **Extension Period:** Vermont allows an extension of **6 months** to file (moving the deadline to October 15).
* **How Extensions Work:** 
  * Under Act 175 of 2020, Vermont grants an automatic extension of the filing deadline upon obtaining an approved federal extension.
  * If an extension is not submitted through the IRS or if a payment accompanies the request, taxpayers can file an extension online via **myVTax** or submit **Form IN-151** (*Application for Extension of Time to File Form IN-111*) by the April deadline.
  * An extension of time to file does **not** extend the time to pay; tax owed must be paid by the original April due date to avoid statutory interest and late payment penalties.
* **Official URLs:** 
  * https://tax.vermont.gov/file-extension
  * https://tax.vermont.gov/individual/filing-season-faqs

---

### 2. Corporate & Pass-Through Due Dates & Extensions (Tax Years 2025 & 2026)

* **Corporate Income Tax (C-Corporations):**
  * **Due Date:** Due on the date prescribed for filing under the Internal Revenue Code (for calendar-year C-corporations, the 15th day of the 4th month, i.e., **April 15**).
  * **Extensions:** An extension of time to file a federal return automatically extends the Vermont filing deadline to **30 days beyond the federal extension date** (granting corporations 1 additional month past the 6-month federal extension). Taxpayers may also request an extension online via myVTax or by filing **Form BA-403** (*Application for Extension of Time to File Vermont Corporate/Business Income Tax Returns*). Tax must be paid by the original due date.
* **Pass-Through Entities (S-Corporations, Partnerships, LLCs):**
  * **Due Date:** Due on the date established for filing under the Internal Revenue Code (for calendar-year partnerships and S-corporations, the 15th day of the 3rd month, i.e., **March 15**).
  * **Extensions:** An extension of time to file the federal pass-through return automatically extends the time to file with Vermont to **30 days beyond the federal extension date**. Entities may also submit **Form BA-403** or file through myVTax by the original due date. Tax due (including the $250 minimum tax) must be paid by the original due date.
* **Official URLs:** 
  * https://tax.vermont.gov/business/corporate-income-tax
  * https://tax.vermont.gov/business/business-entity-income-tax
  * https://tax.vermont.gov/file-extension

---

### 3. Elective Pass-Through Entity Tax (PTET / SALT Cap Workaround)

* **Status (TY 2025 & 2026):** **Does not exist.** Vermont has not enacted an elective pass-through entity tax. Legislative proposals (such as S.45) were introduced but were not passed into law.
* **Rate and Election Rules:** Not found / Not applicable.
* **Official URLs:** 
  * https://tax.vermont.gov/business/business-entity-income-tax
  * https://legislature.vermont.gov/statutes/section/32/151/05920

---

### 4. Composite or Group Nonresident Returns (Tax Years 2025 & 2026)

* **Availability:** Business entities may elect to file a composite return and pay tax at the entity level on behalf of owners who are nonresidents of Vermont (Schedule BI-473 filed with Form BI-471).
* **Mandatory Requirement:** Composite filing is **mandatory** for pass-through entities that have **more than 50 nonresident** partners, members, or shareholders (32 V.S.A. § 5914(b); 32 V.S.A. § 5920(b)).
* **Rate:** Mandated composite payments are calculated at the **second-highest marginal individual income tax rate** under 32 V.S.A. § 5822.
* **Official URLs:** 
  * https://tax.vermont.gov/business/business-entity-income-tax
  * https://legislature.vermont.gov/statutes/section/32/151/05914
  * https://legislature.vermont.gov/statutes/section/32/151/05920

---

### 5. Estimated Tax Payments & Nonresident Withholding for Pass-Throughs (Tax Years 2025 & 2026)

* **Nonresident Withholding / Estimated Payments:** 
  * Pass-through entities are required to make quarterly estimated income tax payments on behalf of nonresident shareholders, partners, or members on income attributable to Vermont. 
  * Entities cannot delegate the requirement to make these payments to the nonresident owner.
  * If composite filing is elected or mandatory, payments are applied to the entity’s composite return.
* **Payment Schedule:** 
  * Due in four installments on the **15th day of the 4th, 6th, and 9th months** of the tax year and the **1st month of the subsequent year**.
  * For calendar-year entities, installments are due on **April 15, June 15, September 15, and January 15**.
  * Remitted using **Form WH-435** (*Estimated Income Tax Payments For Nonresident Shareholders, Members or Partners*).
* **Entity Minimum Tax:** 
  * Pass-through entities (partnerships, LLCs taxed as partnerships, S-corporations) owe an annual minimum entity tax of **$250** (32 V.S.A. § 5921; 32 V.S.A. § 5915), due on or before the federal return due date.
* **Corporate Estimated Tax Threshold:** 
  * C-corporations anticipating a Vermont tax liability over **$500** must pay quarterly estimates on the 15th day of the 4th, 6th, 9th, and 12th months of the tax year.
* **Official URLs:** 
  * https://tax.vermont.gov/business/business-entity-income-tax
  * https://legislature.vermont.gov/statutes/section/32/151/05921
  * https://tax.vermont.gov/business/corporate-income-tax

---

### 6. Main Return Forms (Tax Years 2025 & 2026)

* **Individual Income Tax:**
  * **Form IN-111:** *Vermont Individual Income Tax Return*
  * **Form IN-151:** *Application for Extension of Time to File Form IN-111*
* **Corporate Income Tax:**
  * **Form CO-411:** *Vermont Corporate Income Tax Return*
  * **Form BA-403:** *Application for Extension of Time to File Vermont Corporate/Business Income Tax Returns*
* **Pass-Through Entities:**
  * **Form BI-471:** *Business Income Tax Return* (standard pass-through return)
  * **Form BI-476:** *Business Income Tax Return (For Resident Only)* (simplified return for entities owned solely by VT residents with only VT income/loss)
  * **Schedule BI-472:** *Non-Composite Schedule*
  * **Schedule BI-473:** *Composite Schedule*
  * **Schedule BI-477:** *Vermont Income Adjustment Calculation: Pass-Through Nonresident*
  * **Schedule K-1VT:** *Shareholder, Partner, or Member Information*
  * **Form WH-435:** *Estimated Income Tax Payments For Nonresident Shareholders, Members or Partners*
  * **Form BI-470:** *Business Income Tax Return Payment Voucher*
* **Official URLs:** 
  * https://tax.vermont.gov/forms-and-instructions
  * https://tax.vermont.gov/business/business-entity-income-tax
  * https://tax.vermont.gov/individual/personal-income-tax
